posts.html:
The global energy landscape is undergoing a significant transformation. With increasing investments in solar energy, wind power, battery storage, green hydrogen and renewable technologies, the importance of reliable infrastructure, product quality and technical compliance continues to grow.

Recognising the importance of this evolving industry, TIC Quality Control (TICQC) participated in the Renewable Energy India Expo 2026, held from 22 to 24 October 2026 at India Expo Centre & Mart, Greater Noida, India.

The event brought together manufacturers, technology providers, energy developers, investors, industry experts and other stakeholders from across the renewable energy ecosystem.

For the TICQC team, participation provided an opportunity to explore emerging technological developments, understand evolving industry requirements and engage with the growing renewable energy sector in India.

Renewable Energy India Expo 2026: A Platform for Industry Collaboration

The Renewable Energy India Expo (REI Expo) is one of India’s major industry platforms dedicated to renewable energy technologies, products and solutions.

The 2026 edition provided an opportunity for businesses and industry professionals to explore developments across several segments of the clean energy ecosystem.

Key industry areas included:

  • Solar energy generation and manufacturing
  • Wind energy technologies and infrastructure
  • Battery manufacturing and energy storage systems
  • Green hydrogen and renewable fuels
  • Bioenergy and waste-to-energy solutions
  • Electric mobility and charging infrastructure
  • Power electronics and grid integration

The exhibition highlighted how technological innovation, manufacturing capabilities and industry collaboration are shaping the future of clean energy.

India’s Renewable Energy Sector: Growth and Emerging Opportunities

India is steadily strengthening its position in the global renewable energy market. Government initiatives, private-sector investments, technological advancements and increasing demand for cleaner energy sources are contributing to the expansion of renewable energy infrastructure.

Solar power remains a major contributor to this transition, while wind energy, bioenergy and energy storage are becoming increasingly important components of India’s energy ecosystem.

The expansion of renewable energy creates opportunities across several industries.

1. Solar Energy

Solar energy is one of the fastest-growing renewable energy segments in India.

The sector includes solar photovoltaic (PV) modules, solar cells, inverters, mounting structures, trackers and associated electrical equipment.

As manufacturing and installation capacities expand, maintaining product quality, electrical safety and performance consistency becomes increasingly important.

2. Wind Energy

Wind power plays an important role in diversifying renewable electricity generation.

Wind turbines, blades, gearboxes, generators, towers and associated components must meet relevant technical and safety requirements.

Reliable equipment and appropriate inspection procedures are essential for supporting long-term operational performance.

3. Battery Energy Storage Systems (BESS)

Battery Energy Storage Systems (BESS) help address the intermittent nature of renewable energy generation.

These systems store electricity generated during periods of high production and release it when demand increases or renewable generation decreases.

Battery performance, thermal management, electrical safety and system reliability are important considerations throughout the battery supply chain.

4. Green Hydrogen

Green hydrogen is produced using renewable electricity to power water electrolysis.

It is being explored for applications in industries such as steel, chemicals, fertilisers, transportation and other energy-intensive sectors.

Its development requires appropriate equipment, process safety measures, technical standards and reliable infrastructure.

5. Bioenergy and Waste-to-Energy

Bioenergy solutions use organic materials, agricultural residues, biomass and other suitable waste streams to produce energy.

These technologies can contribute to resource efficiency, waste management and the development of circular economic systems.

Why Quality Assurance Matters in the Renewable Energy Industry

Renewable energy projects involve complex supply chains, specialised equipment, large-scale infrastructure and multiple technical requirements.

A defect in a critical component, inadequate manufacturing control or failure to meet applicable specifications can affect equipment performance, project timelines, operational safety and overall investment.

This makes quality assurance in renewable energy an important consideration throughout the value chain.

Some major areas where quality assurance plays a role include:

1. Raw Material and Component Quality

The quality of raw materials and individual components can directly influence the performance and reliability of renewable energy equipment.

Appropriate verification helps businesses assess whether materials and components meet defined specifications.

2. Manufacturing Quality Control

Manufacturing processes require consistent monitoring to maintain product specifications, production quality and process reliability.

Manufacturing quality control procedures can help manufacturers identify deviations and improve production consistency.

3. Inspection and Testing

Inspection and testing services provide technical information about product characteristics, performance and conformity with applicable requirements.

Depending on the product and assessment scope, testing may include electrical, mechanical, dimensional, environmental or safety-related evaluations.

4. Regulatory Compliance and Certification

Renewable energy equipment may be subject to national regulations, international standards, contractual specifications and market-specific conformity requirements.

Understanding applicable requirements before manufacturing, procurement or export can help businesses avoid unnecessary compliance complications.

5. Supply Chain Verification

Renewable energy projects often involve suppliers, manufacturers and equipment sourced from different countries.

Independent verification and appropriate documentation can contribute to supply chain transparency, procurement confidence and quality management.

The Role of Testing, Inspection and Certification in Sustainable Development

Testing, Inspection and Certification (TIC) services form an important part of industrial quality infrastructure.

These activities help businesses obtain independent technical information, evaluate conformity and demonstrate compliance with relevant requirements.

Although each activity has a different purpose, they work together to strengthen quality and confidence across industrial supply chains.

Testing

Testing involves evaluating materials, products or equipment against defined technical requirements or test methods. It helps determine specific characteristics, performance parameters and safety-related properties.

Inspection

Inspection involves examining products, materials, equipment, processes or facilities to determine whether they meet specified requirements.

Depending on the assignment, inspection may take place during manufacturing, before shipment, at installation or during other defined stages.

Certification

Certification provides formal attestation that a product, process, service or management system meets specified requirements within the scope of an applicable certification scheme.

Certification should be performed by an appropriately competent and recognised certification body within its authorised scope.

Together, these activities contribute to better quality management, risk reduction, regulatory compliance and confidence among manufacturers, suppliers, buyers and project stakeholders.

How Quality Standards Support Renewable Energy Infrastructure

Renewable energy equipment operates in different environmental and industrial conditions.

Solar installations may experience high temperatures, humidity, dust and prolonged exposure to sunlight, while wind energy equipment must withstand mechanical loads and changing weather conditions.

Battery storage systems also require careful consideration of electrical and thermal safety.

Applicable standards and technical specifications help establish consistent requirements for product design, manufacturing, testing, installation and operation.

Depending on the product and application, relevant standards may come from organisations such as:

  • International Organization for Standardization (ISO)
  • International Electrotechnical Commission (IEC)
  • Bureau of Indian Standards (BIS)
  • Other applicable national and international regulatory authorities

It is important for manufacturers and project developers to identify the correct standards and regulatory requirements for their specific equipment and target markets.

Compliance should always be evaluated against the relevant product category, intended application and applicable technical scope.

TICQC’s Participation: Connecting Quality with Industry Innovation

TIC Quality Control (TICQC) believes that quality, technical competence and compliance awareness are essential elements of sustainable industrial development.

The team’s participation in Renewable Energy India Expo 2026 reflects its interest in understanding evolving industry requirements and engaging with businesses operating across emerging technology sectors.

The exhibition provided an opportunity to observe developments in renewable energy manufacturing, energy storage, clean energy technologies and supporting industrial infrastructure.

The TICQC team, including Manish Kumar, participated in the exhibition to explore industry developments, gain insights into emerging technologies and understand the growing importance of quality assurance across renewable energy supply chains.

With its experience across testing, inspection, quality control and conformity-related services in multiple industries, TICQC recognises the importance of maintaining product integrity, meeting applicable requirements and building confidence throughout supply chains.

TICQC continues to focus on delivering professional quality solutions that support businesses in managing quality, safety and compliance requirements across their respective industries.

Building a More Reliable and Sustainable Energy Future

The transition towards renewable energy is not only about generating electricity from cleaner sources. It also requires dependable manufacturing processes, reliable equipment, responsible supply chains and appropriate technical verification.

As India’s renewable energy ecosystem continues to develop, collaboration between manufacturers, technology providers, project developers, regulators and quality assurance professionals will remain important.

Industry platforms such as Renewable Energy India Expo create valuable opportunities to exchange knowledge, understand emerging challenges and explore solutions that can contribute to long-term industrial development.

TICQC is pleased to have been part of Renewable Energy India Expo 2026 and looks forward to continuing its engagement with evolving industries where quality, safety and compliance matter.

To learn more about TIC Quality Control’s inspection, testing and quality solutions, visit www.ticqc.ae.

India’s agricultural and food processing industries play an important role in strengthening the country’s economy, supporting food security and creating opportunities across domestic and international markets. Among these sectors, the soybean and edible oil industry holds significant importance due to its contribution to food production, animal nutrition, industrial applications and agricultural trade.

Recognising the importance of this evolving industry, the TIC Quality Control (TICQC) team attended the International Soya Conclave 2026, organised by the Soybean Processors Association of India (SOPA) at the Brilliant Convention Centre, Indore, Madhya Pradesh.

Presented by Alfa Laval, the conclave was centred around the theme “Atmanirbhar Bharat – Powering the Oil & Protein Vision.”

The event brought together industry leaders, soybean processors, researchers, agricultural stakeholders and business professionals to discuss developments, challenges and opportunities across India’s soybean and edible oil value chain.

For the TICQC team, the event provided an opportunity to gain valuable industry insights, understand evolving market dynamics and strengthen professional connections within the agricultural commodity and food processing sectors.

International Soya Conclave 2026: A Platform for Industry Knowledge and Collaboration

The International Soya Conclave 2026 provided a platform for discussions surrounding India’s soybean economy, edible oil production, processing technologies and the future of the oilseed industry.

Organised by the Soybean Processors Association of India (SOPA), the conclave focused on strengthening the soybean processing sector and exploring opportunities to enhance India’s position in the global oilseed and protein market.

The event encouraged discussions around several important industry areas, including:

  • Soybean production and processing
  • Edible oil manufacturing and refining
  • Soybean meal and protein production
  • Agricultural commodity markets
  • Processing technologies and industrial innovation
  • Domestic and international trade opportunities
  • Supply chain development and market competitiveness
  • India’s self-reliance in edible oils and protein production

Such industry gatherings are important for exchanging technical knowledge, understanding market developments and encouraging collaboration between different stakeholders.

Understanding India’s Soybean Industry

Soybean is one of India’s important oilseed crops, offering value through both its oil and protein-rich by-products.

The crop has applications across multiple industries, making it an important agricultural commodity for farmers, processors, manufacturers and traders.

The soybean value chain includes several stages:

1. Soybean Cultivation and Agricultural Production

Soybean cultivation contributes to India’s agricultural economy, particularly across major producing states such as Madhya Pradesh, Maharashtra and Rajasthan.

Crop productivity depends on factors such as seed quality, climatic conditions, soil characteristics, agricultural practices and harvesting methods.

Maintaining appropriate agricultural practices and post-harvest handling is important for preserving commodity quality.

2. Soybean Processing and Oil Extraction

After harvesting, soybeans are transported to processing facilities where they undergo cleaning, grading and preparation before oil extraction.

Processing methods may include mechanical extraction and solvent extraction, depending on the facility and production requirements.

The extracted crude soybean oil can undergo further refining to produce edible oil suitable for consumption.

3. Soybean Meal and Protein Production

Soybean meal is an important by-product of soybean oil extraction.

It is widely used in animal feed and poultry nutrition because of its protein content and nutritional value.

The quality and nutritional characteristics of soybean meal are important considerations for feed manufacturers and buyers.

4. Edible Oil Refining and Distribution

Crude soybean oil undergoes refining processes to remove unwanted impurities and improve its suitability for consumption.

The refining process may involve degumming, neutralisation, bleaching and deodorisation.

The final product enters the edible oil supply chain through manufacturers, distributors, wholesalers and retailers.

The Importance of Quality Control in the Soybean and Edible Oil Industry

Quality control is an essential part of agricultural commodity processing and food supply chains.

From raw soybean procurement to final edible oil distribution, maintaining consistent quality helps businesses meet customer expectations, contractual specifications and applicable regulatory requirements.

Several quality parameters are important throughout the soybean and edible oil value chain.

Soybean Quality Assessment

Raw soybean quality may be evaluated through parameters such as:

  • Moisture content
  • Foreign matter
  • Damaged and discoloured seeds
  • Broken and immature grains
  • Oil content
  • Protein content
  • Presence of contaminants, where applicable

These parameters can influence processing efficiency, storage conditions and the commercial value of the commodity.

Edible Oil Quality Testing

Edible oil quality is evaluated using relevant physical and chemical parameters.

Depending on the product and applicable specifications, important parameters may include:

  • Free fatty acid (FFA) content
  • Acid value
  • Peroxide value
  • Moisture and volatile matter
  • Iodine value
  • Saponification value
  • Colour and clarity
  • Fatty acid composition

Appropriate testing helps manufacturers and buyers assess product quality and verify conformity with applicable requirements.

Storage and Transportation

Proper storage and transportation are important for maintaining agricultural commodity quality.

Exposure to moisture, unsuitable temperatures, contamination and inadequate storage conditions can affect soybean quality and edible oil stability.

Appropriate handling, storage management and quality monitoring help minimise avoidable losses across the supply chain.

Why Testing, Inspection and Quality Assurance Matter in Agricultural Trade

The international agricultural commodity market involves multiple stakeholders, including farmers, exporters, importers, processors, traders and logistics providers.

When commodities move across domestic and international markets, buyers and sellers need reliable information about product quality, quantity and conformity with agreed specifications.

This is where Testing, Inspection and Certification (TIC) services become important.

Testing: Laboratory testing helps evaluate the physical, chemical and other relevant characteristics of agricultural commodities and food products.

Inspection: Inspection helps assess the condition, quality, quantity and conformity of commodities at different stages of handling, storage, processing and shipment.

Certification: Certification provides formal confirmation that a product, process or system meets specified requirements within the scope of an applicable certification scheme.

Together, these activities contribute to greater transparency, quality assurance and confidence across agricultural supply chains.

For businesses involved in soybean trading, edible oil manufacturing and agricultural exports, appropriate quality verification can support better procurement decisions, contractual compliance and international trade requirements.

Atmanirbhar Bharat: Strengthening India’s Oil and Protein Economy

The theme “Atmanirbhar Bharat – Powering the Oil & Protein Vision” highlighted an important area of discussion for India’s agricultural and food processing industries.

Reducing dependence on imported edible oils, strengthening domestic oilseed production and improving processing capabilities are important considerations for India’s agricultural development.

Soybean contributes to this vision through its dual value as an oilseed and protein-rich agricultural commodity.

Strengthening the domestic soybean ecosystem requires attention to several areas:

  • Improved agricultural productivity
  • Quality seed availability
  • Efficient harvesting and post-harvest management
  • Modern soybean processing infrastructure
  • Advanced edible oil extraction and refining technologies
  • Better quality control and testing facilities
  • Stronger agricultural supply chains
  • Increased domestic value addition

Collaboration between farmers, processors, technology providers, research institutions and quality assurance organisations can contribute to the long-term development of this sector.

TICQC’s Participation at International Soya Conclave 2026

The participation of TIC Quality Control (TICQC) at the International Soya Conclave 2026 reflects the importance of staying connected with evolving agricultural and food processing industries.

The event offered the TICQC team an opportunity to explore developments across the soybean processing industry, edible oil sector and agricultural commodity markets.

Discussions and industry interactions provided valuable perspectives on market requirements, processing developments, quality considerations and the changing needs of businesses operating across the soybean value chain.

TICQC recognises that quality assurance, reliable testing, inspection and compliance play important roles in supporting agricultural trade and industrial supply chains.

Through continued industry engagement, TICQC aims to stay informed about emerging requirements and developments across the sectors it serves.

Looking Ahead: Building Stronger Agricultural Supply Chains

India’s soybean and edible oil industries have significant opportunities for growth through technological innovation, improved agricultural practices, modern processing infrastructure and stronger quality management systems.

As the sector continues to evolve, maintaining product quality, improving supply chain transparency and meeting applicable standards will remain important for businesses operating in domestic and international markets.

Industry platforms such as the International Soya Conclave 2026 encourage knowledge exchange, professional networking and collaboration among stakeholders working towards the future of India’s oilseed and protein economy.

TICQC is pleased to have participated in this important industry gathering and looks forward to continued engagement with the agricultural commodity, food processing and edible oil sectors.

To learn more about TIC Quality Control and its quality-related services, visit www.ticqc.ae.

Diwali, the festival of lights, is a celebration of happiness, positivity, gratitude and new beginnings. At TIC Quality Control, the festive spirit came alive as our team came together to celebrate this special occasion with enthusiasm, joy and togetherness.

The celebration was filled with cheerful moments, fun activities and shared happiness, reflecting the importance of building strong relationships and creating a positive workplace culture.

Celebrating the Spirit of Diwali at TICQC

Diwali is more than just a festival; it is an occasion that brings people closer and creates opportunities to share happiness. At TICQC, our team embraced the festive spirit with enthusiasm, making the workplace brighter with smiles, festive activities and positive energy.

The celebrations provided an opportunity for colleagues to step away from their everyday routines, interact with one another and enjoy the festive atmosphere.

Fun Games and Team-Building Activities

One of the highlights of the celebration was the fun games and engaging activities enjoyed by our team members. Filled with laughter, excitement and friendly participation, these activities made the celebration even more memorable.

Such experiences strengthen team spirit, encourage collaboration and build meaningful connections among colleagues. We believe that a strong workplace culture grows through not only professional achievements but also shared experiences that bring people together.

Sharing Festive Happiness and Appreciation

As part of the Diwali celebrations, festive gifts and compliments were distributed to all team members as a gesture of appreciation and goodwill.

It was a meaningful way to recognise the dedication, efforts and contributions of our people. Every individual plays an important role in TICQC’s journey, and occasions like these remind us of the value of appreciating our people and celebrating achievements together.

Building a Positive and Connected Workplace

At TICQC, we believe that people are at the heart of every successful organisation. Celebrating festivals together encourages inclusivity, strengthens relationships and creates a sense of belonging.

Diwali’s message of light, hope and positivity reflects the values we aim to bring into our everyday work: collaboration, mutual respect, continuous growth and shared success.

Spreading Light, Happiness and New Beginnings

Our Diwali celebration was a beautiful reminder that happiness grows when shared. From playing games and enjoying festive activities to exchanging gifts and creating wonderful memories, every moment made the occasion special.

As we look forward to new opportunities and milestones, we carry the same spirit of positivity, teamwork and togetherness into the future.

TICQC wishes everyone a very Happy Diwali!

May the festival of lights bring happiness, prosperity, good health and success to everyone.

Together We Celebrate. Together We Grow.
